Product features

A trust layer your product can use.

AppKeyId combines device-protected credentials, application controls, and visible verification to make digital communications easier to trust.

01

Passkey-backed identity

Use FIDO2 public/private-key cryptography. The user’s private key remains on their device and is unlocked with the device’s local security.

02

Communication attestation

Attach verifiable identity evidence to messages, approvals, and application events where provenance matters.

03

Recipient verification

Let the receiving application distinguish attested interactions from content that merely appears convincing.

04

Developer APIs

Integrate identity and verification flows into mobile, web, and server-side experiences through application interfaces.

05

Application controls

Manage relying-party settings, identity policies, enrollment flows, and access rules from a central portal.

06

Audit-friendly events

Create a clearer record of identity-backed actions to support review, escalation, and incident response.

07

Deployment choice

Start with a hosted service and discuss enterprise or controlled-environment requirements with the AppKeyId team.

See how AppKeyId fits your communication workflow.
